    divider_val = 8

    divider_rows = [i for i, row in enumerate(grid) 
                    if sum(1 for c in row if c != divider_val) <= 0.1 * len(row)]

    print(f"Rows: {len(grid)}x{len(grid[0])}")

    print(f"Divider cols: {divider_cols}")
    
    # Only flip if we have at least 4 rows of regions (3+ dividers)

            flip_rows.append(i)
    
    print(f"Flipping regions at row indices: {flip_rows}")
